advisory.finding: The Cloud parity test `test_account_id_identity_matches_the_live_cloud_backend_state_for_state` compares `AccountIdIdentity.resolve` against `JiraBackend.resolve_assignee`, but the latter now DELEGATES to `AccountIdIdentity` (backend.py:118), so both sides run the identical `_resolve`. merged_from: The Cloud-vs-DC behavioral divergence controlled by `trust_resolved_on_mismatch` (identity_model.py:112) is not verified on the Cloud side. The only Cloud mismatch state (`resolvable-mismatched`) uses resolver result `('a@x.com', True, False)` where the resolved value equals the local value, so the trusted-path `(resolved,...)` and untrusted-path `(local_value,...)` return the same value. No Cloud test uses resolved!=local with is_account_id=False, so flipping Cloud's `trust_resolved_on_mismatch` to True would pass every test.
scenarios: A future edit to `_resolve` (e.g. changing the converged or unmappable branch) regresses assignee resolution; this parity test still passes because both operands changed together.
